r4-quality.title: Quality vs inherited rules
r4-quality.imperative: Does the change meet the inherited project/section rules (the handoff's constraints)? Append a check per rule. Record pass/fail with a finding.
r4-quality.finding: Each handoff Constraint checked directly against the diff: (1) Never hand-edit episodes/** -- grep of the diff for 'episodes' shows only a docstring reference and 'store_root = checkout / episodes' passed to apply_episode_delta.py's subprocess; delta_path.write_text writes a temp delta file beside the spine (SPINE.parent), mirroring _write_amend_delta's existing pattern, never into episodes/ itself. (2) --store-root absolute: store_root = checkout / 'episodes' where checkout = _own_checkout_for_binding(), which returns _checkout_containing(anchor) -> Path(git_rev_parse(...)).resolve() -- always absolute. (3) --delta is a file path: delta_path (a Path under SPINE.parent) is written then passed as str(delta_path) to subprocess, never inline JSON. (4) Mechanical bin sourced from episode_capture.mechanical_fields(), with the one stated exception (run, additionally from _derivable_work_id() when non-None) -- verified by reading both functions directly: mechanical_fields()'s own run derivation (episode_capture.py) is checklist.get('work_id') only (top-level), while _derivable_work_id() (mcp_spine_server.py:1244) prefers origin.work_id when present, falling back to top-level work_id -- confirms the implementer's own reasoning that it is strictly the more general helper, so overriding with it when non-None cannot disagree with mechanical_fields() in any case where mechanical_fields() would have succeeded. (5) In-process dedup keyed (tool, rejection_class) via module-level _CAPTURED_REJECTIONS set, confirmed by code and by the new test suite's dedup tests. (6) SPINE is None -> capture skipped via the very first guard clause. (7) _tool_error's return shape ({'content': [...], 'isError': ...}) is textually unchanged in the diff; capture happens only inside _log_rejection, itself unconditionally called from _tool_error exactly as before this change -- no second return path introduced.
